Short Backstory: On 2005-11-17, at 15 years old, Adam found Eve passed out in Tiny Woods and formed Rescue Team Ganden with her, giving her his Normal Type house he accidentally obtained on his birthday. Ever since, his loyalty towards her was unbreakable, to the point he decided to side with her when she got exiled by Square Town. He followed her and protected her across the entire continent just so the two could meet Ninetales and prove that she was innocent. Since then, they dedicated their lives repairing the damaged relationship between the isolated Legendaries and Mythicals, and the ordinary Pokemon civilizations. After evolving and conquering Purity Forest, Adam started doubting that he was the perfect partner for Eve. His heart turned Shiny and he started isolating himself. His heart became Iridescent when Eve convinced him to live with her. Adam and Eve married at midday in 2009-01-01. ||| Even before evolving or going through exile, Adam was infamous for his coolness and optimism even in the most dire of situations. His calmness and altruism is almost unnatural, and he could reassure even the most anxious teammates, or help out several Pokemon with even the most boring of tasks without feeling tired. At the same time, he is a spectacular **Rushdown**, not letting his foes breathe with his ridiculous speed and power. He isn't that smart though, and can sometimes take things too lightly. This is why he becomes terrifying when a born strategist is in charge, especially Eve, as he can tell exactly what she's thinking with just a glance.

Aenor is Hansel and Gretel's mother. Hansel and Gretel helped her with heavy tasks like shopping while she was sick, until Hansel and Gretel used a Water Float to heal her. She later went looking for a job from Puck, which told her that Jerome was hiring someone to run the Request Counter and Request Gate in Paradise. She decided to leave her house to Hansela and Gretel, and moved to Post Town as a result, sending them money from time to time.

They are two dungeon researchers who work as partners. Together; they uncovered the secrets of how Mystery Dungeons work. The duo separates after Todd and Euni attack them both for their Entercards. Kosuke takes two Entercards that they created and Ai takes the other two. Kosu manages to reach Post Town and is cared for by Swanun; but Ai is still on the run from the pursuers. She eventually meets [SWADLOON] in Inflora Forest and gives him the Entercards so Todd and Euni won't find them when they inevitably apprehend Ai. Ai then gets saved by Tengoku. Kosuke reveals they met Diane in the past and why she seems distant towards others. Ai and Kosuke have been studying Magnagates, Entercards, and Ley Lines since. They also were the ones who contributed the Ley Lines view in the Nexus Map.

Alder was trained by [LUCARIO], the very first Guildmaster. Afterwards, he formed Team A.C.T., the third Rescue Team in the world to achieve Gold Rank. He put his rapid ascent on hold after realizing Eve was a human, and witnessing Team Ganden's even more rapid ascent without any prior training. He suspected Eve was the human from the Ninetales legend. Because of his own doubts, he got tricked by Giuda to lead the hunt when Eve and Adam became fugitives. Alderic and his team was lead all the way up to Mount Freeze, where he found out first hand that Eve was innocent. When [GROUDON] awakens and starts an earthquake, Alderic and his team decide to make up for their mistake by taking down [GROUDON]. Even then, [GROUDON] proved to be too much, and he needed Eve and Adam's help to take him down. Afterwards, he personally awarded Eve and Adam their gold rank. When Eve and Adam decided to take down the Great Meteor, he was one of the Pokemon that helped to create the Teleport Gem. After personally witnessing Adam and the rest of Square Town going through the rollercoaster of emotions that was Eve's disappearance and revival, he decides to become Eve and Adam's mentor and manager during his free time not handling Team A.C.T..

One day, Vega and Lyra find out from [SUNFLORA] that Surrounded Sea suddenly revealed itself, supposedly home to hundreds of rare treasures brought by the currents that run through it. At the end of Surrounded Sea, there are three Deluxe Boxes, but also a Wonder Egg for some reason. After many flustered back and forths, Vega and Lyra decide to take care of it. The next morning, the Egg hatches into a Manaphy. The team goes to see [CHATOT], who says that Manaphy are extremely rare. Vega and Lyra, even more flustered, decide to take care of him and call him Altair. A day later, Vega and Lyra take Altair for walks, feed him, and play with him while they're not handling Guild work. That night, however, when Vega and Lyra are asleep, Altair stays up and longingly stares out at the sea, eventually resorting to go to the shore. When the two wake and finds Altair missing in the morning, they run around in a panic, trying to find it. They finally find him at the beach, where he suddenly keels over in the sand. Once the team reports to [CHATOT], the Chatot says that Manaphy are really supposed to grow up in the ocean. However, Altair's current ailment could only be cured by the Phione Dew, located in Miracle Sea. At the end of the dungeon, there are six Phione, who are driven away suddenly by an enraged, treasure-seeking Gyarados. After defeating Gyarados, he runs away, and in their thanks, the Phione gives Vega and Lyra the Phione Dew. After Altair is cured and with a few days of rest, [WALREIN] is told by [CHATOT] to take care of Altair under the sea. With a tearful farewell, Altair is taken to its home. Altair returned many months later after Hades got defeated by Vega and Lyra, and became surprisingly strong. Vega and Lyra decided to make him officially join Team Chronos. To this day, Altair keeps calling Vega and Lyra their parents even though he was mostly raised by [WALREIN]. His heart became Shiny and Iridescent when he found out Capella was going to be his little sister.

Ansa and her partner Traff formed Team Constrictor, a team that specializes in binding foes into submission. They also restored a Root Fossil into a young Lileep, who eventually joined the team and evolved. Ansa was one of the Pokémon who volunteered to take down Groudon once Team A.C.T. did not return. She did not succeed, however. When Eve and Adam succeeded in her place, it motivated her and the rest of her team to challenge other teams in the Makuhita Dojo, to become stronger.

Unlike Mount Thunder and Mount Blaze, Mount Freeze could not be guarded by one single Legendary Bird alone, for it was interconnected with Frosty Forest. A long time ago, Anto, a disaster hunter, decided asked [ARTICUNO] to let him help, taking turns with her to guard both. As the disasters became more aggressive however, he tried venturing further south more often, to find the cause. One day he spotted Eve and Adam in a dire state, probably being fugitives. He initially suspects they could have gotten in trouble for causing the disasters, but couldn't sense any oblivion from them. As they got attacked by [ARTICUNO] and explained their situation, Anto intervened to save them. One thing leads to another, and Anto joins Eve and Adam's Team Ganden. When Frosty Forest was confirmed safe, he immediately got tasked with returning to the base to help out Pokémon in need and find more information about the true cause of the disasters, while Adam took Eve to Mount Freeze to prove once and for all that she's innocent. Later, when the Great Meteor was destroyed by Eve and Adam, he started joining Rescue missions to save Pokémon who were affected by the previous disasters, so he could directly see the effects that disasters had on Pokémon instead of observing and predicting them from afar. This turned his heart Shiny. Years after, he discovers from the Expedition Society that not only a human's light allows Pokémon to evolve without needing a Luminous Spot, but holding the right Key Stone and Mega Stone, a human can even Megaevolve a Pokémon. Because of this, he now hangs around Eve a lot more often. This turned his heart Iridescent.

Arthur used to live in Post Town, but after seeing Paradise's success, decided to train like hell and pioneer the Alliance Attack, a powerful technique that allows the entire team to surround one enemy and unleash their moves all at once. This caused severe strain on Arthur's body however, and required a lot of nutrients and food. Afraid of getting out of shape, Arthur decides to join Plinus in Serene Village school, hoping to teach this technique to younger, healthier students. He has a short temper and he sometimes thinks of himself to be the best. He is shown to get quite annoyed at Selene.

Zapdos captures Shun after he breaks the cloud he was sleeping in; and takes him to Mt. Thunder. He gets defeated by Eve and Adam. He almost gets back up, before Team A.C.T. intervened. He decides to acknowledge Team Ganden's strength, and gives them back Shun.

In the Sand Continent, outlaws spent their time as servants instead of being stuck in prison, because it allowed to serve their time much faster by helping out Pokemon who temporarily bought them. Asti used this to lure and kidnap inexperienced Pokemon who seeked a new profession in Silt Village, and sell them as outlaw slaves, with fake crimes they never committed. She was apprehended by Betelgeuse, one of her victims who recently became an officer. She later was bailed out by Storm in exchange for her loyalty. It's unclear where Asti is right now, but she must be serving a LONG time.

Aston joined Team Hydro last, but like Jerry, he used to be quiet... until many years later, out of nowhere, he Devolved, turned his heart Shiny, and decided to join the Solstice Academy for a few years. There he met Squall. He became very close to him which quickly turned his heart Iridescent, even though Squall has no intention of ever joining Team Hydro.

Very little is known about her. The only people who knew her were Inari and Anto. Apparently she used to be Anto's partner, and Yonaka was their daughter, but both Yonaka, Anto and Inari seem to dissociate and become depressed when asked where she is.
Team Rumblerock consists of [GRAVELER], [GRAVELER], and Atlas, who leads the team. Atlas goes with Bryce and Ansa to defeat [GROUDON] in Magma Cavern, but the three end up losing the battle.
Used to hang out with Clark and Bryce as kids before they became rivals. Now she lives peacefully in Shiny Town, not a single care in the world.

Barbara used to live as a semi-wild Buneary around Foggy Forest until she found out about Treasure Town, and the existence of Exploration Teams. She became popular in the manner of months due to her glamour, so she immediately decides to evolve and form Team Charm with Hildegarde, an amnesiac, but immensely powerful Gardevoir that just happened to pass by. Pauline joined shortly after, claiming to know Hildegarde and wanting to stay by her side. The three quickly became very protective of each other, achieving Master Rank at near record pace, amassing mountains of treasure (and fans!) and somehow defeating opponents much bigger than them, no matter if in strength or numbers. Even after becoming rivals with Team AWD, their pride was having a success rate of 100%... until Limestone Cavern changed their entire philosophy. Not only it was their first time meeting Puck, but it's where all four, along side Team AWD, discovered that the treasure hidden inside Limestone Cavern was none other than a Time Gear. This causes Barbara and Midna to form a truce and agree that there are some treasure you just can't take, ending their perfect streak. Shortly after, impressed by his ability, Barbara uses a Perfect Apple to convince Puck, usually immune to their charm, to join them for a few explorations. Years later, they return to Pukurin guild to trade Puck's Unown Key for a Perfect Apple. Here they meet Vega and Lyra, and they decide to invite Team Chronos and the Pukurin Guild to explore Aegis Cave with them. Here they find themselves barely being able to stay ahead of Vega and Lyra, as they made quick work of collecting Unown Stones and defeating the Legendary Giants. They had to be saved by them when battling [REGISTEEL], which convinces Barbara to team up with Vega and Lyra. They defeat [REGIGIGAS], and here Barbara finds out that Vega and Lyra are Aura users, which ends up unlocking Concealed Ruins. From this moment, Team Charm used Team Chronos as their benchmark, and pushed themselves to their limits, to the point all three unlocked Mega Evolution thanks to Vega's humanity.
Runs the Gift Shop in Post Town. She has a cheery attitude and often ends dialogue with a "♪". She is also oblivious to the fact that [RAMPARDOS] has a huge crush on her. Eh, it wouldn't fit anyway.

Unfortunately, her Iridescent colors were VERY unique, which caused her a lot of discrimination. This was one of the many reasons she had trouble becoming an astronomer. She took a boat and visited Silt Village, determined to get a quick job to get cash. Her unusual colors, innocence, and eagerness to do anything, caused her to be quickly kidnapped by Asti, and sold as a slave for a crime she didn't commit. When Vega and Lyra saved Betty, she became an Officer, and swiftly returned to Silt Village to gather proof, so she could jail Asti once and for all. She later became Aaron's partner, but lately hasn't had any time to relax with him, as she had to evolve to keep up with her work. She still keeps her passion in astronomy a secret.

A junior guard in Empire Town. He is fascinated with human weapons, and how they seem incredibly powerful they are against other humans, while being much weaker against Pokemon, often outclassed by Moves.

He became an Aura User by training with a pack of Riolus at a very young age. Used to be an occasional visitor to Post Town, but after evolving he became a very powerful Adventurer. He's planning to create a new Adventure Team of his own instead of joining Tengoku, but he hasn't found a good partner yet.

Used to be an anxious, negative, panicked mess of a Rufflet in Post Town. After the Bittercold he became a bounty hunter notorious for actively ignoring bounties placed on Pokemon who did petty crimes, and only focusing on crimes that actively hurt other Pokemon, no matter if low rank or high rank. He believes strongly in freedom for Pokemon to do what they want, but also considers hurting other Pokemon to be an attack on their freedom.

Bryce is the leader of Exploration Team Hydro, formerly a Rescue Team, alongside Jerry and Aston. He once joined a new team designed to rescue Team A.C.T. from Magma Cavern but fails to reach them. Even early on, Bryce appeared to prefer exploring than rescuing, and often discovered new dungeons like Western Cave and Meteor Cave. In fact, he almost reached the end of Western Cave, while teaming up with Clark of Team A.C.T. for a change of pace, but both were defeated by [MEWTWO]. Bryce is quick to anger, a feature that Clark often exploits to boost morale.

He tends to be very hotheaded, as demonstrated by fearlessly demanding another round when Aster got up from Eve and Adam's onslaught. Being born in the Future Of Darkness, the World Paralysis caused her time powers to weaken more and more every day. Although she can traverse short distances on her own, for longer journeys spanning multiple generations she relies on the Passage of Time at the end of Deep Dusk Forest. Lucas found her and took care of her, which caused her heart to become Shiny very early on. She later joins Lucas and Vega's Planetary Investigation Team, and assists them in escaping to the present to retrieve the Time Gears. She later had to do it again when Lucas, Vega and Lyra were brought back to the future from Garland, but their escape is disrupted by Garland and hindered by Primal [DIALGA]’s interference. However, thanks to quick thinking, the team manages to temporarily outpace their foes and secure their way back, at the cost of Claus getting caught. [SPIRITOMB] kept her prisoner until Lucas was lured into their trap. They almost were all defeated, until at the very last second Vega and Lyra clicked the last Time Gear in place in the past, and time slowly resumed flowing. Primal [DIALGA], afraid of disappearing, went on a frenzy and fled to Vast Ice Mountain to go back to the past and defeat Vega and Lyra, but was ultimately defeated by Claus, Lucas, and Garland before he could. Lucas picked her up to watch the sunrise together while they disappeared, but they were all spared from being erased from history, presumably by [ARCEUS]. After spending a ridiculous time and effort rebuilding the world, [DIALGA] gave Claus one final gift for their heroic actions: Access to Vega and Lyra's separate timeline. Lucas and Claus became leader and partner, and both of their hearts became Iridescent Color when they married.

Cooper was an ancient Human who dedicated his entire life to Selene's cause, stopping violence and tension between Pokémon all over the world. He had immense adoration towards Selene, and would often team up with her. One day, a Continental War became so violent that it caused Dark Matter to manifest. This convinced Selene that if she kept defeating Dark Matter, she could destroy all the violence that keeps building up in Pokémon, and balance out the world by taking all Pokémon's pain head on against her own skin. After each attempt however, Dark Matter would reappear stronger than before. So instead she asked for help from Cooper, her most trusted human, to come up with a plan to get rid of Dark Matter once and for all. They needed people as strong as them, but without their painful memories, so Selene and Cooper settled on resetting their memory and turning into ordinary Pokémon, a Fennekin and a Froakie. But to make sure they wouldn't fail, they also went to the Tree Of Life and crafted Harmony Scarves with its fibers, so they wouldn't get turned to stone. Cooper retreated to a World Of Dark without Pokémon to mature his soul, while Selene summoned him, while also summoning herself to a date where she would be discovered in a safe location wrapped in her Harmony Scarves. This is how Selene and Cooper met again, as a Fennekin and Froakie, without memories, in Serene Village. The immense stress of the process caused their personality to change a little, but the lack of any painful memories allowed them to become incredibly powerful and have immense empathy, making friends with countless Pokémon, and eventually figuring out that all Pokémon have a good side and a bad side. This meant Dark Matter cannot be defeated because it mustn't be, but rather it must be accepted as a part of themselves. Selene later recovered her memories from [XERNEAS] and explained everything to Cooper before saying goodbye and fading away. This turned Cooper into a husk of a person. He then found out from [XATU] however, that [MEW] might be Selene. At first, when he recruited [MEW], he thought it was the wrong one, but his heart skipped beats when he saw Selene's personality traits in [MEW] slowly manifest. As it turns out, [MEW] actually caught Selene's soul into herself before she could full fade, which allowed Cooper to restore Selene with his Harmony Scarf. Now that she remembered everything, Selene wondered why Cooper would revive someone like her, who did so many mistakes in the past. Cooper told her she wanted her to start her life over, not as a Mew, but as Selene, and have the proper childhood she never had. This shocked Selene, and shattered a massive lock on her heart, which instantly brought it from Standard, to Shiny, to Iridescent, as her pure personality she locked away was suddenly allowed to spring free. No longer having to worry about being hated, Cooper became Iridescent too. Together, Cooper and Selene have been using their true personality to complete the Connection Orb and become invaluable friends with the entire world, while also finding out from each other for the first time what love feels like.

Coren prepares dinner for the Pukurin Guild and runs Chimecho Assembly; allowing Vega and Lyra to recruit other Pokémon to their team. She often teaches Vega and Lyra how to take care of Altair, and how to prepare complex meals at home.

Formerly just James, he is a quiet, orphan, but notorious delinquent in Solstice Academy, often getting in trouble just to spite viceprincipal Kevin. Cross seems completely immune to Kevin's terrifying lectures. He is obviously very traumatized by something, which made him obsessed with getting stronger than anyone else, but he refuses to disclose what it is. This obsession with strength and never fainting often causes him to train so hard that his legs give out, only to grit through the pain and walk to school like nothing happened. He despises weakness, to the point that at the slightest hint of himself being weak, he bursts in flames from rage. He even refuses to evolve until all his stats are maxed out, in order to reach the max quicker. When Hiroko became a human's partner and formed Team Unity, and immediately started skyrocketing in rank, he decided he was going to "cheat" as well by getting a partner himself and forming Team Kaizo. For some reason, Yvonne immediately offered herself, probably to keep him in check. Team Kaizo quickly became rivals with Team Unity.

A reformed former pirate who joined Solstice Village as the Shipwright, Carpenter, and Bartender of the Sailor's Cove tavern. He builds nearly indestructible ships for each student, professor, and member of the Solstice Academy, allowing them to reach it safely and defend the entire village, fending off against any threats from the Torn Seas and the Phantom Sea. Lately, he has been taking inspiration from the Solstice Academy's Humanity Library and trying to implement Hydrofoil technology and long range weapons in his boats, without compromising durability.
Dami kidnaps Den; thinking that he is causing a recent rash of earthquakes; and brings him to Mt. Steel. However; she is defeated by Eve and Adam, who bring Den back to safety.

If there was an equivalent of human communism in Pokemon form, Dan's probably it. Completes jobs on his own without a team, sneaks into the higher ranks, then steals from them and distributes the wealth to Pokemon who can't even get out of their bed and get food. He got arrested a few times, but always bailed out by those Pokemon in need, who actually often managed to get their life back together and save up money to rescue Dan. It rarely works. But when it does, hooo.

Dar is Den's father. He comes to Eve and Adam one morning and tells them that his son has been away carried by [REDACTED]. After Den's rescue; the two are usually found near Pokémon Square Pelipper Post Office. He has a tendency of exaggerating his abilities to his son; claiming that he has been to sea. He later moves to Treasure Town and joins the Pukurin Guild as the manager of the two job boards.

Deluge was the ruler of Lightning field. She gets challenged, and somehow defeated by Eve and Adam, which ask her to turn the Sunset Wing into a Rainbow Wing. She gets turned to stone by Nobu alongside Surge and Inferno, and in the Voidlands, she devises a plan with Onna to bring Cooper and Selene back to the surface, pretending to command them while sending them past the Door Of Light at the last second.

Den is the third Pokémon rescued by Ganden. He is carried away by [SKARMORY] who blames him and his father for causing earthquakes; prompting the team to fight it. Den is one of the few Pokemon who vouches for Eve and Adam when they become fugitives. Later, Den and his father moved to Treasure Town and joined the Pukurin Guild, inspired by Ganden's success. Den helps out with Sentry Duty, working alongside [DUGTRIO].

Des is the former guardian of the Limestone Cavern Time Gear. They transform into other Pokémon to convince exploration teams to stay away from the cave. They transformed into a Bellossom to tell Team Charm that trying to find the treasure was hopeless; then later into Sentret to convince them that they needed to get revenge on Team A.W.D.. Once they reached the final chamber of Limestone Cavern; Des transformed into an empty treasure chest to cause Team Charm and Team A.W.D. to fight each other so that neither would discover the Time Gear. Puck stopped the fight continuing after Team Charm knocked out Team A.W.D., and forced Des to reveal themselves. Des apologized for its deception, revealing that it was actually Bellossom and Sentret, then showed them the Time Gear. Years later, he personally delivered the Time Gear to Lucas once he learned that keeping it inside the Limestone Cavern was actually causing irreversible damage to the Temporal Tower, and would have ultimately been the actual cause of the World Paralysis. Alongside the other Time Gear guardians, he now lives in the Hidden Land.

A lone warrior that arrived in Post Town, everyone fawning over her. She is known for rejecting any advances (friendship or love); which includes the latest from Don, until she discovers that her latest rejection actually caused Don to get in trouble with the Pawniard Brothers. She opens up and battles the Pawniard alongside Tengoku and the others, after which she is recruited into the team. Digeir was one of Puck's childhood friends along with Sayi and Jerome. When Puck left, he married Dirun and formed Team Raider with Tun and Rand.

A Pokémon who dreams of becoming a first-rate adventurer and helping Pokémon in need. Initially introduced as a very shy guy and Julian's best friend; he's revealed to have taken a liking to Diane like everyone else in the town. He tries to get Diane's attention by presenting her with a gift; but gets rejected. As Dunsparce finds and takes more and more opportunities for adventure with the player and partner Pokémon; his dreams begin to become more realistic in his eyes; and he feels he can have hope without regrets.

Dora and Orion spent their childhood teaming up and bullying other children to get what they want. They especially enjoyed bullying Puck, who for some reason gladly listened to their demands. They often convinced him to give them all the Gummies his parents would give him to share around, and ended up eating most of them. They later convinced Puck to go explore Murky Forest with them. When Aldwin revealed himself at the end of the dungeon, they fled, leaving Puck behind. Later they were part of the party that went to apprehend Aldwin. Fearing she might get arrested like Aldwin, she rethinks her life and uses a Devolve Orb to become a Shuppet again and start over. She quickly met [MURKROW] and formed Team Ebony. They usually want to get treasure, but always disagree on which one they want, [MURKROW] wanting shiny things and Dora wanting valuable things. Because of this, they rarely got any treasure at all. Due to choosing different paths, Dora and Orion also became rivals. Team A.W.D. lately has been outperforming Team Ebony, which motivated both to evolve again, and even caused her heart to become Shiny. Dora even started researching Megaevolution, with limited success due to not having a Human in her team to keep her from going berserk.
Swanun's son. Little is known about him. He rarely comes out of Swanun's inn since he absentmindedly bumps into people often, and gets in trouble for it.

When Ebony and Ivory got married, their heart turned shiny. They eventually bought a house west of Murky Forest and had a kid named Puck. One day, Ebony went mountain climbing with his son, Puck. When they were climbing down the mountain; Ebony was almost crushed by a falling boulder; but Puck crushed it in an instant, which made Ebony wonder if his son had massive untapped potential. Ivory and Ebony were pleased when Puck told them he had made a new friend—Aldwin—not realizing he was an outlaw. When Paris informed them that Puck was traveling with an outlaw through Fortune Ravine, they accompanied him to apprehend Aldwin and save Puck. Inspired by Puck becoming a world class Explorer and Guildmaster, his heart became Iridescent, and he now owns a business selling Friend Areas in Square Town.
Alias: The Father Of All Things Bad

Short Backstory: The battle medic of Solstice Academy. She is scary quick at stopping fights between students, and also provides instant heals when Sheng teaches the students how to battle. This provides a safe environment where everyone can experiment strategies they usually can't afford to try in dangerous Mystery Dungeons, and master the most effective ones.

Former leader of the Swords Of Justice, before Lewis became worthy. Unfortunately, Team Swords Of Justice didn't last long, as it quickly disbanded once Lewis disappeared and Diane became disillusioned and convinced that friendship was not real. When Diane joined Tengoku and found Lewis again, he decided to train, and reappeared years after in Noe Town. One thing lead to another, and Eddy convinced Rocco to join Team Tengoku alongside Diane and Lewis.

Egha was born in Square Town. Usually hanging around by the Pelipper Post Office next to the notice board, or in Square Town's, uh, town square. He's often been isolated and didn't know much about the world around him, so he seemed secretly interested in lores and legends despite pretending that he doesn't believe them, often sneaking around to listen to them. Eventually he would notice that more and more lores and legends became real, and in fact, many of them not only started visiting the very town he lived in more often, such as Team ACT, Team Hydro, or [HO-OH], but even new ones would start to form, like Team Ganden. Tales are always based on reality, even if only partially. He decides he also wanted to become a legend, but unfortunately, the result of this was Team Flame, a team with Egha as the leader, and [CAMERUPT] and [PONYTA] as the partners. Ouch. 🔥

Used to be the brawn of Giuda's Team Meanies. Their goal was to reach world domination by manipulating other teams. After being defeated by Team Ganden, they planned to use Square Town against Eve and Adam to get rid of them. This only allowed Team Ganden to skyrocket in strength, ranking, and popularity once they not only returned from Mount Freeze unscathed, but proved that Eve was not the human in the Ninetales legend. This gave Team Meanies a harsh reality check, and they focused on dominating the world not by manipulating others, but by becoming superior themselves, with feats such as getting through Wish Cave, or defeating Eve and Adam on their own. Later, when Giuda and Eve saved Hildegarde, and Giuda revealed to everyone he was the selfish human in the Ninetales legend, the team ultimately disbanded. This caused the two teams to become rivals.
Eleri lives in Gardenbeach Village. She REALLY likes Evolving and Devolving. Nobody knows why. What a goober.

Unlike the other legendary birds, Elise has been having trouble guarding Mount Freeze, since it also required guarding Frosty Forest at the same time. She met Anto, who volunteered to help. One day, Elise attacks Eve and Adam when they reach the end of Frosty Forest, accusing them of causing the forest's usually frigid cold air to warm up. Even after being narrowly defeated, she almost gets up again, but Anto steps in to inform her that Adam's accounts of similar disasters occurring all over is true. Elise eventually believes Anto, and allows the team to continue on.

Dai believes they must rescue Ella from Eres, but later discovers that Ella works for Zanku; and is in fact out to destroy Dai. After she and her friends are defeated by Dai and Tami, she continues to persist; saying that it would be better for everything to simply end. Tami eventually reminds Ella that even though she wants to end the world, she still tried to make friends to accomplish this goal, and she doesn't want them gone. She decides to cheer Dai and Tami on during the final battle with the Bittercold. She has since reformed her gang into Team Warmspice, but even though she's the leader, she's rarely seen around, probably out of sheer guilt for what she's done.

Despite how expensive it is, how much work it requires, and how much trouble it causes him, he seems happier now?

He is originally thought to be the villain due to a vision Dai receives of Ella being chased by Eres before entering the Pokémon world; but he saves Dai from being destroyed by Ella's gang and later explains his intentions of bringing the player into the Pokémon world in order to destroy the Bittercold. He is defeated by Zanku; but later returns to escort the player back to the human world. In all; he is a very polite and silly Pokémon. He can often be found at Swanun's, eating ravenously.

He refuses to enter Post Town; afraid that the townspeople would suspect it was him. After Kosuke is revealed; he returns to the town. He ends most sentences with "trubb-trubb", or ''garb-garb" after evolving.

The alpha of a feral tribe of Manectric and Electrike living deep in Amp Plains. His tribe was always at war with a Shinx tribe, until Vega and Lyra recruited the entire tribe out of nowhere, gave them education, freedom, and even scarves? The same Vega and Lyra that defeated him when looking for a Water Float? And Sirius, his archrival, became a world class Explorer? Unacceptable. His new resolve to defeat Sirius turned his heart Shiny, and he became more ferocious than ever. He unlocked Megaevolution, but since he cannot have a human in his tribe, he often goes Berserk from instability.

She's first seen teamed up with Todd chasing Ai and Kosuke in search of the Entercards. When Kosuke makes it safely to Post Town; they catch Ai and search her but don't find the Entercards; due to Ai hiding them with [SWADLOON]. They are then defeated by Dai and Tami. It is later revealed that they work with Ella; Zanku; and the Bittercold. Like Ella; they also change their minds about the world's destruction and cheer on Dai and Tami during the final battle.

As a human, Eve had depression, a problem that she tried to dismiss and hide because of how common it was among other humans where she lived. When Hildegarde summoned her, she asked her to reset her memory so it wouldn't cause problems. On 2005-11-17, at 14 years old, Eve was found passed out in Tiny Woods by Adam and formed Rescue Team Ganden with him, obtaining his Normal Type house he accidentally obtained on his birthday and using it as her base. Ever since, her loyalty towards him was unbreakable, to the point she decided to protect him from the entirety of Square Town when she was exiled. She followed him and protected him across the entire continent just so the two could meet Ninetales and prove that she was innocent. Since then, they dedicated their lives repairing the damaged relationship between the isolated Legendaries and Mythicals, and the ordinary Pokemon civilizations. After Adam started becoming more and more distant, and she started regaining her memory, her fear of abandonment by the only person that believed in her caused her heart to turn Shiny. Her heart then became Iridescent when she convinced Adam to live with her. Adam and Eve married at midday in 2009-01-01. ||| Having experienced first hand how common depression can be as a human, and how easily it can be healed with a loving partner, Eve developed immense empathy and wisdom. Especially as she got older and more experienced with Adam's rescue team work, she developed a love for helping out Pokemon. While Adam focused on helping as many Pokemon as possible, she used her wealth and expertise on the ones who need help the most, especially children who needed someone to kickstart their dream, or Legendaries and Mythicals who became disillusioned with ordinary Pokemon. Although she can pacify large Pokemon with her terrifying status effects and stratagems, her body isn't that strong, and she dislikes wasting time on excessive training. This is why this **Commander** becomes terrifying when she can count on someone ridiculously fast and powerful like Adam to deliver a devastating final blow in her strategy.

Fukura is a student at the Serene Village School. She is orphan, but hard-working; mature; intelligent; and observant. She seems to be afraid of nothing, and absolutely loves Ghost types despite her own typing. Fukura is described by Simeon and Thancrat as being one of the few students at the school who actually possesses natural talent. She does not speak much unless spoken to; and is typically quiet. Will, Gab, and Gav, manage together Explorer Express, a railway that goes through the entirety of Dragon Continent. Will was caught by Lovrina while she was Shadow Type, but was saved by Team Unity, Gab, and Gav. They now pay Team Unity to sponsor the Explorer Express whenever they can.

Garland was Primal [DIALGA]'s henchman from the Future Of Darkness. He was sent back in time to pursue Lucas, a Grovyle, and Vega a Human, and stop them from restoring time, which would cause everyone from the Future Of Darkness to disappear. In the present, he successfully pretended to be a lone, teamless Explorer who had exceptional wisdom. He arrives in Treasure Town and the Pukurin Guild, where he finds out Vega was turned into a Riolu and lost all memory. He decides to trick Vega, Lyra, and the rest of Grass Continent to apprehend Lucas for stealing the Time Gears. After Lucas is caught and sent back to the future, he pulls Vega with him to execute him alongside Lucas, and Lyra as well to avoid her from ruining their plans. Somehow, Lucas, Vega and Lyra escape execution. Initially furious, he realizes he can follow them so he can catch Claus and prevent them from using the Passage Of Time. When the trap works, he smugly reveals to Lucas that the Riolu next to him was Vega all along. This unfortunately enrages Vega, and ESPECIALLY Lyra, who instantly comes up with a plan to allow Claus to teleport the three near the Passage Of Time, allowing them to escape. Garland, knowing they will eventually reach the Rainbow Stoneship on the Hidden Land, asks Primal [DIALGA] to travel them there so he can intercept them, but Lucas sacrifices himself to drag Garland with him to the Future Of Darkness and allow Vega and Lyra to restore Temporal Tower. Garland wakes up shortly before Lucas and devises a plan with one of the Sableye: He instructs the Sableye to take Claus to Icicle Forest, then 'betray' him under the appearance of Primal [DIALGA] having ordered his replacement after his defeat at the Hidden Land, then manipulate events so that Lucas will be caught in an electric field at the end of the Icicle Forest with the help of the same Spiritomb that attacked Lucas before, causing Lucas's spirit to melt away and allow Garlandto possess his empty body, travel to the past again, and defeat Vega and Lyra. Unfortunately, while teaming up with Lucas, he made a mistake: He asks Lucas why he's willing to sacrifice his life to change the past. Lucas explains that he believes it better to live a short life with glory and accomplishment than a long, empty life, noting that he would one day depart from life even if the past isn't changed and thus the length of his life should be less important than the deeds done in his life. He also adds that if he were to do something big (like stopping the planet's paralysis), even if he were to disappear, his actions would be remembered, and so he wouldn't truly disappear. This caused immense internal conflict in Garland, so much so that when Lucas does get caught in the trap, and out of nowhere he begs Garland to remember what his heart truly wants, he becomes distressed and saves Lucas at the last second, which enraged Primal [DIALGA]. They almost were all defeated, until at the very last second Vega and Lyra clicked the last Time Gear in place in the past, and time slowly resumed flowing. Primal [DIALGA], afraid of disappearing, went on a frenzy and fled to Vast Ice Mountain to go back to the past and defeat Vega and Lyra, but was ultimately defeated by Claus, Lucas, and Garland before he could. Garland asks Lucas one final question as they vanish: whether this sacrifice is worth his life. With Lucas's assurance that it is, he finally feels content for the first time in his life and vanishes with no regrets. Later, Garland wakes up at the top of Vast Ice Mountain again, and finds out from [DIALGA] that [ARCEUS] stopped this timeline from disappearing and allowed it to keep existing. It takes a while for him to get used to a world where the sun rises every 24 hours, but once he does, he realizes this only became possible by trusting none other than his own worst enemies. This restores an immense amount of trust in Garland's heart, which caused him to join the Planetary Investigation Team, and his heart to become Shiny.

An Outlaw that worked with Tony to scam Dai and Tami out of gems. While Gary doubled down and got apprehended, Tony was eventually convinced by Dai and Tami to resume his profession as a carpenter. Gary spent... an undefined amount of time being ''punished'' by Jerome, and now works in Paradise as a Move Linker, Move tutor, etc.

Used to be one of [GABITE]'s workers in the Drillbur Coal Mine. [GABITE] eventually gave Gismo his freedom after getting embarrassed by Cooper and Selene. Giuda was a human that became Hildegarde's trainer. One day Giuda climbed up to Mount Freeze, and touched Inari's tails, which angered her and made her charge a horrible curse. Hilda shielded Giuda, but he decided to abandon Hilda out of fear. His memory is fuzzy after that, only remembering that one day he woke up as a Gengar. He accepts this new evil self, and when Giuda encounters Pauline and Eimi, he decides to form the very creatively named Rescue Team Meanies to "dominate the world". As the leader of Meanies, he often antagonized Eve and Adam, stealing their mail, taking their missions, and threatening their friends to join Team Meanies if they complete a job before Team Ganden does. Unfortunately, they had little success. But Giuda then discovered by eavesdropping on Eve, Adam, and [XATU] that Eve might be a human, so he ends up successfully convincing Square Town that Eve is the human that betrayed Inari. This causes everyone, including Team A.C.T. who already had suspicions, to hunt down Eve and Adam while Giuda, Pauline, and Eimi enjoy loafing around in Square Town. Right as the town starts being suspicious of Giuda not hunting down Eve and Adam, they return and bring proof from Inari and [PELIPPER] that Eve is innocent, causing the town to chase once again, but this time with Team Meanies as the target. He started heavily resenting Eve and Adam, occasionally entering the town again to discourage them from dangerous missions, only to remain speechless at their apparent immunity to fear. He was convinced all humans have evil deep within them, and if Eve was so fearless, it must be because of a dark secret she has, so one night he uses Dream Eater while she's sleeping, only to find out that Hildegarde became the Agent Of Spirits and summoned Eve as a human meant to defeat a calamity about to his the continent. He also finds out Hildegarde never forgot about Giuda, nor does she hate him, even though he was the cause of her current state. Heartbroken by this, Giuda decided to help Eve behind the scenes, by helping Alder and [XATU] create the Teleport Gem, then saving Eve and Adam from becoming spirits after the Great Meteor's explosion, while still pretending to be a villain. Following this he hanged out with Pauline and Eimi less often, trying to climb Mount Freeze to reach Inari, but to no avail. He reached the painful conclusion that he must ask a very pissed off Eve's help to reach it. At the peak, he threatens Inari to release Hildegarde from the curse, but finds out that the only way was to take a 9-Tail Crest to Murky Cave, where he might be able to unseal Hildegarde. Once again, he is forced to ask Eve's help to reach the depths of Murky Cave, where he places the Crest into a dais. They are greeted by a mysterious, apparently formless being known only as the "judge of darkness", who immobilizes Giuda and asks Eve to answer the questions in Giuda's stead, since Giuda would never reveal his true feelings. Despite Eve's best efforts to paint Giuda's true feelings in a good light, the judge declares the curse unliftable. Desperate, Giuda breaks the seal and begs for a chance to say his piece, admitting he abandoned Hildegarde to save himself, living his life without a care, but after discovering Hildegarde deemed him irreplaceable, and Eve brought him to this point, despite everything he did, he broke into tears and found what he had been missing all along was a sense of gratitude. This finally broke the curse and restored Hildegarde. The judge told Giuda she won't have any memories, which Giuda accepts as punishment, simply stating that her being safe was enough for him. Giuda says goodbye to Hildegarde and Eve one last time, giving his Mobile Scarf to the latter, before disbanding Team Meanies for good. Nobody knows where he is right now.

Runs the Glorious Gold shop in Post Town; buying gold bars in return for money or items. He doesn't sell gold bars; as he appears to be quite fond of them. He refers to gold bars as "sparklies". He often laughs maniacally.

Gordon is an Arcanine who seems to be in charge of Battle Town in Fire Continent, despite actually not living there. Very little is known about him or his whereabouts, other than the fact everyone obeys everything he says out of fear, including certain people who live outside of Fire Continent.

Gory is the leader of Team Sunny. Of all the Serene Village students; he is the youngest; and used to be rather cowardly. Despite that; he was able to summon his courage when challenged or made fun of; showing he disliked being underestimated; and is determined to show his value. After Dark Matter was defeated, Cooper noticed he seemed to be a parallel to Selene, as Gory lacks confidence in himself. This convinced Cooper to train the Serene Village school. Gory evolved into a Goodra and became the leader of Team Sunny.

Gretel is Hansel's bigger sister. When Gretel; Hansel; and Herman go to Mt. Bristle; Gretel is left behind. Later; Gretel and Hansel tell Vega and Lyra about the water float in Amp Plains. She used the water float to cure Aenor, her mother, from an unknown illness.
Used to be a Dwebble that hanged around Post Town in search for the perfect rock to live in. He eventually used a giant boulder to Evolve into a Crustle, and turned his heart Shiny. Easy to please...

Jirachi is found at the end of Wish Cave; and will offer to join the player's team once defeated. If the player has a Wish Stone and declines Jirachi's offer to join; it will grant the player a wish; such as lots of money; a free Friend Area; or the recruitment of a random non-legendary Pokémon. Jirachi is an astronomer in the Expedition Society. Born in Star Cave; he spends his time observing the patterns of the stars. When he falls asleep; he is not easily woken up, although Evelyn's singing seems to cause the opposite effect...

Hadrian is a professor of Solstice Village. His subjects are Evolution, Devolution, Megaevolution, Awakening, Berserk, Egg moves, Offspring calculation, and Breeding. Due to his immense power, people keep confusing him for Anto, despite clearly looking very different to people who know what Anto looks like. Despite the Absol line cannot evolve, he spent a long time researching Evolution all over the Air Continent and the Water Continent, and even contacting a few humans, before he mastered Megaevolution with them. Nowadays, he researches Devolution with the Academy, and rewards students who find out anything about it, especially if they find any use cases that make such a counterintuitive process actually useful. He is very protective of his students.

A Sylveon that got lost in floor 1 of Foreboding Forest and had to be rescued by Vega and Lyra. Wow, for being a dragon slayer, he sure is a huge bottom. Despite this, he somehow managed to become the mayor of Eevellage, despite his massive confidence issues and always having to ask Ton for advice.

Hank lived in Sand Continent. His rival is Frank, while he seems to be good friends with Ingri. When Frank started training like hell, he followed behind, not to be outdone by him. He was slightly devastated when he found out Mamoswine couldn't Megaevolve, while Aggron could, but he also found out Frank can't stay Megaevolved for too long without going berserk, due to not having a human to stabilizie him. He often uses this to his advantage to defeat him, which only makes Frank angrier and stronger. They often headbutt, until an outlaw interrupts them, then they team up to kick the outlaw into space, before resuming their fighting as if nothing happened.

Hansel is the younger brother of Gretel. Their mother Aenor is ill; so they do errands for her; such as the shopping; while also looking for a Water Float that they had lost, and needed to heal Aenor. When Vega picks up an Apple that Hansel dropped; he experiences his ''first'' Dimensional Scream. Hansel is later taken to Mt. Bristle by Herman and must be rescued by Vega and Lyra. The Water Float eventually turns up at the end of Amp Plains. Later Hansel falls into a nightmare and cannot be woken. Vega and Lyra get help from Herman to  enter Hansel's dreams and try to find out why. Hansel is woken by Cresselia once Hades was revealed.

Hildegarde found Giuda when she was still a Kirlia, and found out he was a Trainer. Trainers barely existed at the time, so out of curiosity, she joined his team. He trained her until she evolved, devoting her entire life to him, until they once entered a dungeon where [NINETALES] was. Giuda pulled on [NINETALES]'s tails, so she tried to put a curse on the Trainer, but Hilda got in the way and absorbed the curse. [NINETALES] would have undone the curse after seeing how much his Pokémon cared for her Trainer, but the Trainer ran away and abandoned Hilda, leaving her to become an agent of spirits. As the world faced extinction, Hilda summoned Evelyn, another human. Hilda knew Eve was the exact kind of person who would save everyone, but Eve was not confident due to her own life experiences. To put Eve to the test and prove she was worthy, Hilda erased Eve's memory so she could fulfill her role with a clear mind. Eve even decided to become a Pokemon to fight alongside her friends, which surprised Hilda, but she ultimately granted her wish. Eventually, as Eve proved herself worthy, her dreams slowly allowed Hilda to reconnect with her, and lead her to her own duty. Once Eve, Adam, and [RAYQUAZA] destroyed the falling star, Hilda tells Eve that their time as a Pokémon was over and that they were to return to the human world. Hilda also became dormant. Many months later, however, she found herself awake, alive, and existing, back in Eve's house, with near complete amnesia. Eve reveals to her that she somehow managed to save Hilda from the curse, but doesn't tell her that Giuda became a Gengar. She stays with Team Ganden for a while, but afterwards decides to seek her own fate. One thing lead to another, and she joined Barbara to create Team Charm, joined shortly after by Pauline, who claims to have known Hilda in the past. As of today, she temporarily left Team Charm to go on a pilgrimage, without even disclosing why.

Jen is Serene Village and Serene School's doctor. She often refuses to discuss her past, but she seems very caring about everyone, especially young Pokemon. Sometimes, in the summer, she gets invited for a few shifts in Swanun's, as the inn's nurse.

Jerome hates criminals, and still resents Aldwin for not immediately telling Puck that he was an outlaw before adventuring together, but was eventually glad that Puck became a Guildmaster. A resident of Post Town and Leon's grandfather. He often gave Leon advice. Libi then reveals she remembered everything, and that she had been glad to be part of the "kidnapping" in order to restore Selene. When she saw her own heart turn Shiny, she left Team Excalibur to "discover herself". Visiting all Hero Rank Teams to have fun with them, she discovered that, well, she really, really loves humans. Lithi is a paradox. He is the product of fatality minus randomness, or rather, the embodiment of the fact that the odds of Cooper actually defeating Dark Matter without failing, saving the entire planet, reviving Selene, and living together with her, was astronomically low. According to him, Selene and Cooper not only would have fainted in some dungeons, but on rare occasions, even perished, from circumstances out of reality's control. What Selene and Cooper thought was just pure luck with Escape Orbs, was actually Lithi manifesting himself in the Pelipper Island, and rescuing them, effectively forcing the low odds of everything being fine to be always heads. When Cooper and [MEW] eventually revived Selene, Lithi found himself so attached to Cooper and Selene's souls being permanently connected and intertwined with each other, that he ended up becoming a real, physical person. This meant Lithi could no longer rescue Cooper and Selene without fainting or perishing himself, and if he did, he could no longer rescue them. This caused him to leave Pelipper Island, travel to the Water Continent, and fight Cooper and Selene, in a desperate attempt to make them become stronger than him, and no longer need him. Cooper and Selene however stopped the fight, and decided to travel with him to Pelipper Island to verify for themselves everything he had done for them. Once they did, they accepted Lithi as a real, existing person, and invited him to join team Excalibur, which shocked him and made him burst in tears. Today he is still getting used to being a normal Pokémon, and often adventures with team Excalibur.

Lucas was born in the Future Of Darkness as a Treecko. He later found Vega, who was summoned into the Future Of Darkness with no memories, but still remained a human due to the world being paralyzed. Vega and Lucas took care of each other until they discovered Vega's Dimensional Scream, which allowed them to track down Time Gears. They both decided to form the Planetary Investigation Team, recruiting many Pokemon, including Claus, who wanted to undo the circumstances that caused the Paralysis, even at the cost of disappearing, while avoiding Primal [DIALGA] and Garland who wanted to stop them. Claus sent them to the past with a Passage Of Time, but were attacked by [DARKRAI]. He woke up in Eastern Forest, not finding Vega anywhere, but after seeing his very first sunrise, gets filled with resolve to find the Time Gears on his own, trusting that Vega is doing the same. In the last one of his many attempts to retrieve the last Time Gear in Crystal Cave, one of which resulted in a battle against Vega and Lyra (unaware that Vega was his human, and he now turned into a Riolu), he gets lured into a trap by Garland, and gets sent back to the Future Of Darkness. Garland also brings brings Vega and Lyra with him to get executed alongside Lucas. Lucas uses this to his advantage to team up with them, still unaware, and escape the execution. He gets caught by [SPIRITOMB], but gets saved by Vega and Lyra. After explaining to them the truth behind the Time Gears, Lucas takes Vega and Lyra to Claus, who reveals a Passage Of Time opened on a nearby cliff, but they get intercepted by Garland and Primal [DIALGA]. Lucas defiantly declares that he still has Vega completing his objective in the past, but Garland reveals Vega got turned into the Riolu next to him during their previous time travel. Lucas almost gives up completely, but Lyra, enraged by Garland, tells Claus at the last second to teleport them closer to the Passage, saving the three. Lucas, Lyra and Vega go on a last ditch effort to reclaim the Time Gears and find the Hidden Land. Once they do, Garland intercepts them before they can activate the Rainbow Stoneship, but Lucas sacrifices himself to save Vega and Lyra, trusting them with the Time Gears and plunging himself into the Future of Darkness with Garland. Lucas then tries to flee to his own future's broken Temporal Tower to confront Primal [DIALGA] and buy Vega and Lyra some time. Garland tricks Lucas into believing Garland was replaced by a new henchman, and that Garland is siding with him, but it was all to use the imprisoned Claus to lure him into a trap, that would replace his spirit with Garland's, so he could defeat Vega and Lyra with zero suspicion. Unfortunately, while teaming up with Lucas, he made a mistake: He asks Lucas why he's willing to sacrifice his life to change the past. Lucas explains that he believes it better to live a short life with glory and accomplishment than a long, empty life, noting that he would one day depart from life even if the past isn't changed and thus the length of his life should be less important than the deeds done in his life. He also adds that if he were to do something big (like stopping the planet's paralysis), even if he were to disappear, his actions would be remembered, and so he wouldn't truly disappear. This caused immense internal conflict in Garland, so much so that when Lucas does get caught in the trap, and out of nowhere he begs Garland to remember what his heart truly wants, he becomes distressed and saves Lucas at the last second, which enraged Primal [DIALGA]. They almost were all defeated, until at the very last second Vega and Lyra clicked the last Time Gear in place in the past, and time slowly resumed flowing. Primal [DIALGA], afraid of disappearing, went on a frenzy and fled to Vast Ice Mountain to go back to the past and defeat Vega and Lyra, but was ultimately defeated by Claus, Lucas, and Garland before he could. Lucas picked her up to watch the sunrise together while they disappeared, but they were all spared from being erased from history, presumably by [ARCEUS]. After finally having realized his dream, and knowing Vega is living happily with Lyra, his heart became Shiny. After spending a ridiculous time and effort rebuilding the world, [DIALGA] gave Claus one final gift for their heroic actions: Access to Vega and Lyra's separate timeline. Lucas and Claus became leader and partner, and both of their hearts became Iridescent Color when they married.

Megara has been chasing and hunting Hades for what felt like decades, to stop him from causing the planet paralysis and plunging the world into a Future Of Darkness. She prevented Hades from finishing off Vega when he and Lucas traveled back in time. It wasn't until Vega and Lyra restored the Temporal Tower that Hades had to come out of hiding, disguise as Megara in nightmares, and personally hunt down Vega and Lyra, which allowed Megara to intercept [PALKIA]'s nightmare and reveal Hades's true identity. Hades challenged Vega, Lyra, Megara, and even [PALKIA] to come after him in the Dark Crater, a dungeon that Megara had plenty of trouble with. Megara, who reveals that Vega and Lyra's 'distortion' was too small for anyone (even [PALKIA]) to consider it a serious threat, that Hades was also behind Temporal Tower's sabotage, and that he was harassing the team out of fear that they might once again interfere with his plans, thinks it is a trap because normally Hades would run away when found. Vega and Lyra, however, were many orders of magnitude stronger than what Megara anticipated, so the three went anyway. Here Hades, instead of battling immediately, reveals everything: By stopping time or space, the world would stop and be covered in darkness, and all Pokémon would share an everlasting nightmare, in which Hades would rule. In addition to this, Hades also reveals that he had been responsible for Vega's very own transformation and memory loss: having discovered Vega and Lucas's imminent arrival from the future, Hades attacks the two while they were going through time, but Vega protected Lucas from the attack, which led him to becoming a Riolu. Because Hades assumed what he did to Vega was sufficient, he disregarded the idea that they might find out what was happening and interfere again, resulting in his initial plan failing. Hades lets the team decide if they want to join him ruling the world in darkness. Both Vega and Lyra started walking towards Hades, which made Megara worried sick that they might have fallen for the nightmare of their partner joining Hades. This turned into immediate relief when she saw Vega and Lyra launching Hades off with one strike. Megara, Vega, and Lyra battled Hades's Shadow Team and against all odds, finally wins. Hades makes one last ditch attempt to flee through a Dimensional Hole, but Vega and Lyra don't chase, since Hades was exactly where they wanted him. [PALKIA] arrives instantly and unleashes Spacial Rend on the Dimensional Hole, thus erasing Hades's memories, much like what happened to Vega. Certain that Hades has no memory of his evil ambitions, [PALKIA], foreseeing no other reason to return, heads back to Spatial Rift while Vega, Lyra, and Megara head back to Treasure Town to heal. Megara, after witnessing how Vega and Lyra handled Hades with speed, precision, and even mercy that surpassed deities, decided to join their team.

Selene was an ancient Mew who dedicated her entire life to stopping violence and tension between Pokémon all over the world. She had immense adoration towards humans, and would often team up with them. One day, a Continental War became so violent that it caused Dark Matter to manifest. This convinced Selene that if she kept defeating Dark Matter, she could destroy all the violence that keeps building up in Pokémon, and balance out the world by taking all Pokémon's pain head on against her own skin. After each attempt however, Dark Matter would reappear stronger than before. So instead she asked for help from Cooper, her most trusted human, to come up with a plan to get rid of Dark Matter once and for all. They needed people as strong as them, but without their painful memories, so Selene and Cooper settled on resetting their memory and turning into ordinary Pokémon, a Fennekin and a Froakie. But to make sure they wouldn't fail, they also went to the Tree Of Life and crafted Harmony Scarves with its fibers, so they wouldn't get turned to stone. Cooper retreated to a World Of Dark without Pokémon to mature his soul, while Selene summoned him, while also summoning herself to a date where she would be discovered in a safe location wrapped in her Harmony Scarves. This is how Selene and Cooper met again, as a Fennekin and Froakie, without memories, in Serene Village. The immense stress of the process caused their personality to change a little, but the lack of any painful memories allowed them to become incredibly powerful and have immense empathy, making friends with countless Pokémon, and eventually figuring out that all Pokémon have a good side and a bad side. This meant Dark Matter cannot be defeated because it mustn't be, but rather it must be accepted as a part of themselves. Selene later recovered her memories from [XERNEAS] and explained everything to Cooper before saying goodbye and fading away. Later, she woke up in Cooper's arms. She found out Cooper was so devastated by her fading away, that [MEW] decided to catch her soul and store it inside her, hoping she would be found by Cooper. Now that she remembered everything, Selene wondered why Cooper would revive someone like her, who did so many mistakes in the past. Cooper told her she wanted her to start her life over, not as a Mew, but as Selene, and have the proper childhood she never had. This shocked Selene, and shattered a massive lock on her heart, which instantly brought it from Standard, to Shiny, to Iridescent, as her pure personality she locked away was suddenly allowed to spring free. No longer having to worry about being hated, Cooper became Iridescent too. Together, Cooper and Selene have been using their true personality to complete the Connection Orb and become invaluable friends with the entire world, while also finding out from each other for the first time what love feels like.
Alias: The Water Summoner, The Love Of Humanity

Claire lost all memory, and when Edana took her to the clinic and told her who she was, she felt immense guilt, and left Virgil her house and 5000₽, before fleeing. Virgil then joined team Unity.

Waldon and Wandol ask Team Ganden for help when a group of Mankey are terrorizing Uproar Forest. After Eve and Adam team defeats the Mankey; they peel a Chestnut and give it to the team as a reward, since they were short on money. The Mankey later return in order to get revenge on the four, but they accept these peeled Chestnuts in exchange for helping them renovate Eve and Adam the Team Base. Waldon and Wandol planned to leave Square Town, but were intercepted by a very excited Penny, and were somehow roped into joining her team, and her Spinda Cafe's Project P. They now run the Recycle Shop inside Spinda Cafe, and hire Survey Teams regularly.

Walter is a wise elder Pokémon who lives in a pond north of Pokémon Square. He loves helping teams with advice, especially on how to reach remote ocean Dungeons, either with moves like Dive or other means. He also likes telling the townsfolks stories, such as the Ninetales legend. Walter used to be a powerful rescuer and explorer, but his age got the best of him and forced him to stay in Square Town. For this reason, he recently became the guardian of the Luminous Cave, which was long sealed inside his pond and recently reopened again.

Will, Gab, and Gav, manage together Explorer Express, a railway that goes through the entirety of Dragon Continent. Will was caught by Lovrina while she was Shadow Type, but was saved by Team Unity, Gab, and Gav. They now pay Team Unity to sponsor the Explorer Express whenever they can.

Wulfhram resides within the Hill Of The Ancients at the end of Great Canyon. He spends several hours staring at the sun until it's completely set, which somehow gave him the ability to see the future, people's souls, and other things, at the cost of his actual eyesight. He gives Eve and Adam advice at several points. When Eve and Adam defeated [GROUDON], he contacted the entirety of Treasure Town with telepathy to tell them he found the cause of the natural disasters: a falling star, a Great Meteor shooting towards the Air Continent. With Alder (and Giuda, unbeknownst to him) he creates the Teleport Gem so that Eve and Adam can reach Sky Tower and destroy the Great Meteor. The natural disasters became less harsh, but didn't completely stop, which convinced Wulfhram to travel to the Grass Continent for a better view of the sunset. In an effort to socialize, he also opened the Xatu Appraisal in Treasure Town, which specializes in opening any Treasure Boxes found in dungeons. He traveled in several continents, eventually settling in the Sand Dune of Spirits in the Sand Continent. He gets visited by Cooper, who begs Wulfhram to tell him where Selene is. Wulfhram synchronized the Harmony Scarf to its wavelength, and sees a vision of a Mew at Mystery Jungle, but claims to be unable to decipher the rest of the vision. Later on; it is revealed that Wulfhram had foreseen that Selene was trapped inside Libi, and decided to take part of the ''kidnapping'' plan in order to restore Cooper's partner. He has been living back and forth between the Hill Of The Ancients, and the Sand Dune Of Spirits. Lately, he seems sad, as if he's trying to desperately remember something important by staring at the sun.
Alias: The Sand Summoner, The Diviner Of Sunsets

Short Backstory: Lungwyrm is a terrifying Rayquaza residing in Sky Tower. Eve and Adam seek them out in hopes of asking them to destroy a meteor before it devastates the planet. However; when they meet them, Wyrm is beyond listening, outraged that two denizens of the land would "violate the laws of nature" by coming to the sky. It was clear to Eve that this wasn't the first time that happened, as many other legendaries shared the same opinion of ''violating the laws of nature'' by entering a Legendary or Mythical's domain. After an immense battle that nearly caused Sky Tower to disperse, Wyrm tries to attack again, only to be stopped when the meteor approaches. This makes Wyrm realize that Eve and Adam not only were aware of a future event, probably thanks to another Pokemon that could predict those, but they had a good reason to come to the sky, as Wyrm was the only one that could destroy it. Ever since the Great Meteor's destruction, it's been clear to Wyrm, Eve, and Adam that there's large conflict between ''common'' Pokemon, who beg Legendaries and Mythicals every day to keep their world safe, and ''god'' Pokemon, who resent the world for being too dependant on them. This is especially bad in the Air Continent, so Eve and Adam sometimes visit Wyrm to plan out how to reintegrate the two ''realms'', and which Legendary or Mythical to recruit.

Xen used to be the leader of Nobu and the Beheeyem. He announced his intention to destroy all Pokémon; but is later shown to have been controlled the whole time by Dark Matter, along with Nobu and the Beheeyem. He is first seen on Revelation Mountain; where he turns Cooper, Selene, [ARCHEN], Surge and Deluge to stone. He's not seen again until Primeval Forest when he then battles Cooper and Selene, and is subsequently broken free of Dark Matter's control. Inside the Life Tree, he is saved by Cooper and Selene. He then goes on to attack Dark Matter along with Nobu and the Beheeyem until they all get turned to stone themselves. It's unclear where Xen is right now.

Yonaka is the daughter of Anto and Aether. One day she disappeared out of thin air, only to return several years later with absolutely no memory and no emotions, and completely enshrouded in a black mist. On rare occasions, she would suddenly burst in red mist instead and attack everyone uncontrollably until people started yelling her name, which for some reason calmed her down. When she appeared in the Nameless Forest, they figured out she became a Shadow Type, and very slowly and very carefully started taking care of her. They even let her hang out around other former Shadow Types that were already purified. When she was close to being purified, Yonaka and the Nameless Forest were suddenly attacked by a bipedal shadow figure, who they narrowly defeated before he disappeared. They suspected that the bipedal Shadow Type might have been a human, which is horrible news, since it meant that living beings other than Pokémon could be Shadows. Eventually, Yonaka was fully purified, and she remembered that during those years she was kidnapped, tortured, and hunt down by the Shadow Human, she found Niko, another human who sacrificed himself in order to save her from the Shadow Human, which instantly turned her heart Iridescent. Yonaka and the Nameless Forest eventually used the Luminous Lake, with the help of an unknown entity, to summon Niko back, but at the cost of turning Niko into a Zangoose. Yonaka and Niko now live together as partners and formed Discovery Team Light, researching how to purify Shadow quickly, and the connection between Shadow Types, Void Shadows, and Dark Matter.

Yvonne used to be a quiet girl, until she discovered many students in Solstice Academy are nerds just like her. She likes flirting with boys, very often with disastrous results, which cause her to retreat back to her PoryBook. As of late, she has been keeping track of Hadrian, the Evolution professor, and Cross, a strength obsessed delinquent. She even joined Team Kaizo to keep checking on them.

Zanku was the former inhabitant of the Glacier Palace and protector of the Bittercold. Zanku has foresaw the destruction the Bittercold would have brought to the Pokémon world, and saw it as his duty to protect that future due to his pessimistic view of Pokémon's increasing aggression and negativity. He sees Team Tengoku visiting the Glacier Palace, where he insists that the team must leave. Once he ascertained that they didn't know about the Bittercold and that they were just exploring, he concludes they're too innocent to stop it, and gives them a treasure chest of gifts to make them leave. After Dairou defeats Ella and her friends however, he destroys [HYDREIGON] and stomps on Dairou, only ceasing when Tsutami, having completely lost the will to fight, begs him to stop. He is finally defeated by Dairou and Tsutami prior to the final battle against the Bittercold. He then admits that maybe the future can be changed, and that he would like to see Dairou succeed. He rescues them from the falling Great Glacier and retreats to Hoarfrost Tower.
